maddeler.e:
تقتتلوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَتِلُوا (taqtatilū) /taq.ta.ti.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# تُقْتَتَلُوا (tuqtatalū) /tuq.ta.ta.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
